treaty_name: Agreement between the Republic of Estonia and the Kingdom of Bahrain for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2012)
eif_quote: Estonia MoF table (No. | Jurisdiction | Initialled | Signed | Ratified | In force from | Effective from | MLI effective from): 6. | Bahrein | 06.05.2010 | 12.10.2012 | 11.12.2013 ( est / eng ) | 23.12.2013 | 01.01.2014 |
source_title: EE-BH Agreement 2012, English text (Riigi Teataja annex 537XII_Leping_inglise_k_L2.pdf)

rates.quote: 1. Dividends paid by a company which is a resident of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State and beneficially owned by that resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.
1. Income from debt claims arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.
1. Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.quote: Estonia reserved MLI Art. 35(7)(a); its Art. 35(7)(b) notifications (25.11.2021, 01.06.2022) do not include this treaty, so the MLI (incl. PPT) has not yet effect.

notes: Article 11 is titled 'Income from debt claims' (interest). All three categories taxable only in residence State. No protocol. Ratification act: https://www.riigiteataja.ee/akt/220122013004.
